name: audit-pack
description: Assemble the evidence bundle, sampling and workpapers an auditor asks for — for one framework over one audit window — from Noru's graph plus the local files an integration cannot reach, and land the tested conclusion for each control back in Noru.

interface.shortDescription: Assemble the pack an auditor asks for, and file the conclusions.
interface.longDescription: Asks Noru which controls a framework puts in scope and what is already linked to each, gathers the local artifacts an integration cannot reach, draws a sample anybody can redraw from a population export, and writes a workpaper per control for a person to test and conclude. The pack — index, workpapers and sampling worksheets — is a local deliverable; what lands in Noru is the tested conclusion for each control over the window, mapped to the control it is about.
capabilities: Scope and coverage from the organization's own framework mapping
Reproducible sampling seeded from the population's digest
A workpaper per control, with what was inspected and what was concluded
Conclusions that expire from the end of the window, not the signature
interface.defaultPrompt: Build an audit pack for my framework covering the first half of this year.
